title: Prabowo Formally Nominates Destry Damayanti as Permanent Bank Indonesia Governor
detail: President Prabowo Subianto submitted a presidential letter to the House of Representatives (DPR) nominating Acting Governor Destry Damayanti as the sole candidate for permanent Governor of Bank Indonesia, following Perry Warjiyo's early resignation in July. Analysts noted Destry's experience spanning academia, financial markets, and banking positions her to maintain policy continuity, though her elevation — following a resignation triggered by a call from a Prabowo confidant — has fueled concerns that the central bank's traditional independence is eroding as the president pursues more accommodative monetary policy and a broader commodity-export centralization drive.
